role: retrospective mechanism probe on existing Phase-A caches; not confirmatory detector evidence

source.splits: reuse frozen pair-grouped train/validation/test assignments from splits.csv

views.suspect_absolute: Pauli representation from the backdoor victim
views.paired_checkpoint_drift: backdoor-victim representation minus clean-victim representation on the same input

estimation.direction: attack mean minus clean mean on train pairs only
estimation.score: Sigma_ridge^{-1} delta projected on features centered by train-clean mean

calibration_shift: clean-calibrated rank FPR on train clean
clean-calibrated rank FPR on independent test clean
KS distance between validation-clean and test-clean scores

interpretation_gates.supports_representation_hypothesis: paired drift has positive mean test-AUC delta for both middle and output checkpoints in at least two of three representation families, with no sign reversal across all three seeds for at least one family
interpretation_gates.calibration_warning: independent test-clean FPR exceeds 0.075 or train-clean and test-clean FPR differ by more than 0.05
interpretation_gates.stop_positive_mechanism_claim: drift advantage is absent or direction stability is not positive across seeds

mandatory_qualifications: Phase-A clean and backdoor victims were trained independently; this probe cannot establish a causal poison-only checkpoint effect.
The fitted direction uses poison labels on the training split and is an oracle mechanism probe, not an unsupervised screening result.
Full Pauli is a 1023-dimensional oracle representation and is not a deployable measurement claim.
Only three archived seeds are available, so intervals describe paired sample uncertainty rather than population-level seed uncertainty.
